name: DatensEE Pipeline
description: Parallelize Earth Engine exports across Dataflow workers.

parameters.name: configFile
parameters.label: Pipeline config GCS URI
parameters.helpText: GCS URI of the pipeline-config.json staged by the datensee CLI.

parameters.name: numberOfWorkerHarnessThreads
parameters.label: Per-worker fetcher thread count
parameters.helpText: Beam pipeline option that caps in-flight HTTP fetches per worker. Tile fetches are I/O-bound, so we want more threads than vCPUs.

parameters.name: autoscalingAlgorithm
parameters.label: Autoscaling algorithm
parameters.helpText: THROUGHPUT_BASED enables Dataflow's autoscaler; NONE pins the pool to numWorkers. Passed as a Beam option because the Flex Template environment field for this knob is silently ignored.
